## Summary
- Remove invalid `script_stop` input from `appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.2`
- Set explicit `port` / connection `timeout`
- Document that SG must allow **TCP 22** from GitHub Actions (not only your IP)

## Note
The failed run’s real error was `dial tcp :22: i/o timeout` — EC2 SSH is unreachable from the runner. After opening SG 22 (and confirming the instance is running / IP matches `EC2_HOST`), re-run **Deploy to EC2**.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Fix deploy SSH timeout warning + SG docs
